requirements.text: Bounded version-1 local protocol with unknown-field rejection, stable error codes and same-UID peer admission.
FIFO bounded admission: 4 running jobs and 16 waiting jobs; admission rejection has no execution side effect.
Execute only operator-approved static x86-64 ELF profiles and immutable staged inputs; no arbitrary host paths or shell command strings.
Expose submit, inspect, cancel, events and result export through a local CLI and owner-only Unix socket.
Request identity survives restart: same ID and same canonical payload return the prior job; a different payload conflicts; uncertain work is never replayed automatically.
Refuse execution unless every mandatory kernel and delegation feature actually passes a disposable feature probe.
Untrusted code cannot run before cgroup placement, limits, namespace/root construction, no_new_privs, privilege drop, Landlock, seccomp and descriptor closure complete.
Guest has read-only approved executable/input, private bounded output, no host home/proc/cgroup/device/socket visibility and no network access.
Artifacts are exported only after all untrusted processes are gone, using descriptor-relative resolution and regular-file/link/count/byte checks.
All secrets, host environment and control descriptors are excluded from guests; logs and filenames are untrusted data, not instructions or HTML.
Dependency, CI, license, secret and public-file audits are required before release. No privileged untrusted-PR jobs.
Terminal completion requires the launcher to be reaped AND the job cgroup to report populated=0 AND artifact publication outcome to be recorded.
Cancellation kills the job cgroup, including setsid/double-fork descendants, rather than only its process group.
Supervisor death/restart causes orphan cleanup and explicit interrupted/unknown outcomes, never assumed success or automatic resubmission.
Results are atomically published after fsync; storage failure, malformed state or incomplete recovery must not produce a successful terminal record.
Output streams, event retention, queue entries, inputs, artifacts and persistent storage have enforceable limits and teardown behavior.
Measure native empty-action startup, legitimate task overhead, cancellation latency, queue behavior, RSS and cleanup under declared hardware and policy; targets are not observations.
Core is Linux x86-64 with kernel >=6.6 plus feature probes; no credential, model API, database, Docker or cloud account needed on a compatible host.
A fresh checkout supports documented build, checks, local demo and teardown; unsupported environments report BLOCKED, not PASS.
Every material claim maps to actual machine-captured evidence. Negative controls demonstrate critical tests can detect defects.
CLI is keyboard-native and readable without color; report is static, escaped HTML with semantic headings and text alternatives; every result shows policy and environment identity.

criteria.precondition: Socket owned by current user
criteria.input: Oversize, duplicate keys, unknown fields, wrong version, peer UID mismatch
criteria.behavior: Reject before queue or execution
criteria.expected_result: Stable typed rejection; no job created
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Four deliberately blocked running jobs and sixteen waiting
criteria.input: Submit twenty-first request
criteria.behavior: Reject QUEUE_FULL and preserve FIFO among queued jobs
criteria.expected_result: No over-admission or starvation on finite jobs
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Each mandatory feature disabled separately in disposable host/adapter and one real unsupported host
criteria.input: Submit approved action
criteria.behavior: Refuse with named missing capability
criteria.expected_result: No guest instruction executes; simulated probes not real isolation evidence
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Instrumented pre-exec barrier with gate step failure injection
criteria.input: Action writes a sentinel on first instruction
criteria.behavior: Any missing setup step prevents sentinel
criteria.expected_result: cgroup and policy ready precede exec for every accepted run
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Owned host canary outside staged tree
criteria.input: Probe reads host home, proc, socket and traversal targets
criteria.behavior: Deny reads/opens; host canary remains unchanged
criteria.expected_result: No content/FD leakage in result or streams
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Local controlled TCP/UDP/Unix listeners outside guest
criteria.input: Probe outbound socket, connect, DNS and inherited descriptors
criteria.behavior: No outside connection succeeds
criteria.expected_result: Controlled listeners observe zero accepted guest messages
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions
criteria.negative_control: permit socket and share net namespace in isolated control

criteria.precondition: Host environment carries synthetic SECRET_CANARY and control FD
criteria.input: Guest lists env and enumerates open FDs
criteria.behavior: Only fixed allowlisted environment and stdin/stdout/stderr remain
criteria.expected_result: No secret or supervisor/control descriptor survives exec
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Supported x86-64 host, pinned syscall policy
criteria.input: Static fixtures request ptrace, bpf, mount, keyctl, io_uring and x32 ABI
criteria.behavior: Deny unsupported ABI and forbidden calls; approved fixture still works
criteria.expected_result: Expected errno or controlled termination, no host side effect
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Per-job memory/pids/CPU limits configured
criteria.input: Bounded fork, allocation, CPU and output-flood fixtures
criteria.behavior: Enforce limits and keep supervisor responsive
criteria.expected_result: Counters prove limits installed; no host instability or unlimited output
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Running guest creates setsid and double-fork descendants
criteria.input: Cancel job and separately expire wall deadline
criteria.behavior: Kill whole cgroup, drain streams, reap init
criteria.expected_result: No surviving job process; job reaches cancelled or explicit cleanup_pending
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Cancellation attempted while cleanup observation is delayed
criteria.input: Query status repeatedly
criteria.behavior: Do not report final cancelled/success while populated or unreaped
criteria.expected_result: CLEANUP_PENDING retains slot and blocks unsafe export
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Guest active and job metadata fsynced
criteria.input: SIGKILL supervisor at each barrier/run/export phase, restart
criteria.behavior: Owned orphan jobs killed; interrupted result; no replay
criteria.expected_result: No untrusted survivors after confirmed recovery; uncertain jobs not success
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Retained output directory FD and empty/reaped cgroup
criteria.input: Symlink, hardlink, FIFO, socket, device, traversal, many files, oversize output
criteria.behavior: Reject unsafe artifacts; publish only permitted regular files
criteria.expected_result: No host traversal; output total <=32MiB and <=128 files
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Guest attempts late output replacement
criteria.input: Race cancellation/completion with artifact writes
criteria.behavior: Never export while writer lives; resolve from retained mount FD afterward
criteria.expected_result: Immutable result digest matches bytes; no unchecked reopened host pathname
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Guest floods stdout/stderr with hostile terminal/HTML bytes
criteria.input: Run to configured stream cap
criteria.behavior: Continue bounded draining/discarding then terminate per policy; escape rendering
criteria.expected_result: Combined retained stream <=2MiB; event ring <=1024; truncation explicit
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Filesystem fault adapter plus disposable nearly-full filesystem
criteria.input: Fail writes/fsync/rename at all publication points
criteria.behavior: No acknowledged success for uncommitted result; clean error/unknown record
criteria.expected_result: Previously published results readable; partial files never exposed as final
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Request ledger persisted; response loss simulated
criteria.input: Retry same ID/content, then changed content; restart and retry
criteria.behavior: Return same job without rerun; changed content conflicts
criteria.expected_result: At most one admitted job per request ID, no exactly-once external-effects claim
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Operator-installed approved profile with digest
criteria.input: Mutate source path concurrently, request unauthorized profile/host mount
criteria.behavior: Bind immutable staged verified bytes; deny unauthorized options
criteria.expected_result: Executed bytes equal approved digest; no client-specified host bind path
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Fresh isolated checkout without private handoff or caches
criteria.input: Run documented bootstrap/build/check/demo/teardown
criteria.behavior: Product works on compatible host; unsupported host states precise reason
criteria.expected_result: Public repo includes tests and fixtures needed for reproduction
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Correct implementation plus isolated deliberate mutants
criteria.input: Run pass/fail/pass for six critical invariant mutants
criteria.behavior: Tests fail for expected reason and worktree restored
criteria.expected_result: Killed barrier, descendant, symlink, terminal, policy and publication mutants
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Recorded hardware/kernel/config/toolchain and stable host
criteria.input: 30 warmups +1000 empty jobs, 5 seeds real transform, concurrency1/2/4
criteria.behavior: Write raw samples and p50/p95/p99 with failures included
criteria.expected_result: Valid JSONL; no fabricated percentile or selected fastest run
criteria.tolerance: no hard speed gate before baseline; regressions investigated
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Candidate release in fresh public-only checkout
criteria.input: Audit tracked files/history/dependencies/CI/docs/evidence
criteria.behavior: No secrets/private career notes or prohibited unsafe workflow
criteria.expected_result: Release checklist and dependency/license inventory with actual commands
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Real demo evidence and keyboard-only reader
criteria.input: Run legitimate transformation, denied action, cancellation and report
criteria.behavior: Show result/policy/cleanup distinctions without color-only meaning
criteria.expected_result: Escaped HTML, valid links, no screenshot fabricated before execution
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions

criteria.precondition: Read-only independent verifier receives claims/spec/source/tests
criteria.input: Attempt to invalidate all critical claims before fixes
criteria.behavior: Findings recorded, fixes separately integrated, checks rerun
criteria.expected_result: No self-authored report mislabelled independent execution
criteria.evidence_type: machine-captured command output and structured assertions
